title: Chapter 21 House For Rent, Old Man With Broken Sword
content:
Chapter 21 House For Rent, Old Man With Broken Sword

Hearing this, everyone reacted.

As soon as they entered the city, they were so surprised that the giant city was so shocked. Now, they suddenly realized that the city seemed empty.

There was no one in those loft houses.

"Damn, there are still restrictions in this room, so I can't get in."

One person wanted to enter the house to check, but suddenly realized that he could not enter.

When everyone heard this, they began to try it one after another, but found that they really couldn't get in.

"What does this mean?"

Everyone was puzzled.

At this moment, a figure slowly walked towards the deep city.

He only took one step and suddenly appeared in front of everyone.

Seeing this scene, Ye Hanshuang looked solemn.

Shrink the ground into an inch!

A powerful person in the holy realm.

And this person is Zhang Cheng, the son of Old Man Zhang, a native of the wasteland city.

The young man who was ridiculed by Lao Li three hundred years ago.

Now three hundred years have passed, he is extremely mature, and the rendering of the holy realm makes him reveal the aura of a strong man.

When everyone saw Zhang Cheng, no one dared to come forward to talk to each other.

"Everyone, I am a native of Huangcheng, a native of Huangcheng. If you have any questions, I can solve my doubts."

At this time, Zhang Cheng smiled slightly and spoke actively.

Hearing this, everyone was shocked, but they also breathed a sigh of relief and put down their guard.

"Brother, why are there no one in these houses, and there are restrictions, so you won't let them in?"

After Zhang Cheng finished speaking, a practitioner came forward and said in confusion.

And this is also a problem for most of the people present.

They spent money to enter the city, so they couldn't sleep on the streets. Could it be that this is a scenic spot?

But the scenic spot has accommodations at least.

Hearing this, Zhang Cheng smiled and said, "I'll explain it to everyone."

Zhang Cheng just said indifferently, but the voice was heard by everyone present, extremely loud. Before he knew it, the people entering the city began to gather here continuously.

After a moment, almost all the people entering the city came to Zhang Cheng.

At this time, the number of people entering the city is still increasing.

"The deserted city is divided into three parts."

"We are now in the outer city of the deserted city, and further into the inner city, and then there is the city lord's mansion."

"The outer city is where you who pay the fee to enter the city can set foot."

Hearing this, the man continued, "What do you mean is that we can only be in the outer city?"

Zhang Cheng nodded, "Yes, the environment in the inner city will be better than that in the outer city, but if you want to enter the outer city, you must be a person recognized by the City Lord's Mansion, for example, you have made great contributions to the deserted city."

All of these were told by Lu Daosheng.

"Uh, can you spend money?"

Almost all of them who pay the fees to enter the city are not short of money. If you can spend money, it is of course the best.

Unfortunately, it's obvious that it won't work.

Zhang Cheng shook his head.

"It's definitely not possible to spend money, so it's better to work hard and become a native of the Huangcheng City."

"As for these houses, they can be rented out. After some time, there will be a special person to hand over these things. By the way, be more respectful to them. They are from the City Lord's Mansion, but they have the right to kill and decide. As for renting them You can live in a house or do business."

Hearing this, some business-minded people suddenly began to get ready.

For example, Ji Shengcai among the crowd.

At this time, Ye Hanshuang spoke.

"How can I meet the Lord of the Huangcheng City?"

Upon hearing this, Zhang Cheng was stunned, then shook his head and said, "The city lord is busy with all kinds of things every day, but not everyone can see you. If he wants to see you, he will naturally meet you."

Hearing this, Ye Hanshuang frowned slightly, but she didn't dare to say anything.

She knew that she couldn't afford to mess with this deserted city.

Although I don’t want to admit it, everything in front of her told her that it was the fact.

However, since she couldn't see the city lord, she just looked for it herself. Moreover, the environment here is so good that her state that she had been stagnant for a long time began to become active again.

Let's rent a house first.

Sure enough, after a moment, a group of unified sword-holding guards came to the outer city.

These people all had terrifying auras, and the terrifying pressure on their bodies even made everyone breathless.

Is this the person from the City Lord’s Mansion?

It's so scary.

The leader is Awei.

There is no way, the deserted city has just started, and some of them are still inadequate, so they can only come forward in person.

"If you want to rent a house, come and queue up."

Awei said indifferently.

The scene was silent for a moment, and someone immediately stepped forward.

"Senior, I want to rent that building."

Ji Shengcai was the first to step forward and pointed to the high building in the distance.

Awei said: "In a month, ten million spirit stones, how long will you rent them?"

Upon hearing this, Ji Shengcai's eyelids twitched, he pondered for a moment, and said, "I'll rent it for half a year first, by the way, you can renew the lease."

"Yes, but you have to pay half the deposit first. What is your purpose of renting this?"

"Purpose?"

Ji Shengcai was a little stunned, and he actually asked.

Suddenly, Ji Shengcai's face turned slightly red and he was a little embarrassed. He then stepped forward and put it in Awei's ear and said in a low voice.

After saying that, Awei glanced at Ji Shengcai meaningfully.

You boy.

Ji Shengcai returned a look that he knew everything.

After paying the deposit, Awei took out a piece of paper made of special gold material.

"Sign the contract."

Looking at the paper in front of him, Ji Shengcai looked puzzled, and the people around him also cast puzzled eyes.

Seeing the inexperienced eyes of the crowd, A Wei sneered, and then said: "This thing is called a contract. There are two copies, held by both parties. The contents on it must be strictly followed by the tenants. Once violated, they will pay a sky-high penalty, and my Huangcheng will naturally guarantee your safety during your rental period."

Of course, this is what Lu Daosheng told him.

Hearing A Wei's explanation, everyone nodded.

This Huangcheng is so advanced that even such a thing can be thought of.

It was all verbal before.

Strictly, there will be an oath, unlike here, where the contract is directly taken out.

Ji Shengcai nodded, and then he was relieved.

With the protection of the Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion, it must be much safer to do business.

Then Ji Shengcai signed the contract directly.

After receiving the contract, A Wei took a look at it and confirmed that it was correct. Then he gave Ji Shengcai a copy with the key of the building.

Just like that, the building belonged to Ji Shengcai within half a year.

"Thank you, brother."

Ji Shengcai thanked him and then called for people to go directly to the building.

Then, the others came forward to rent the building.

At the same time, deep in the deserted city, Lu Xue in the city lord's mansion suddenly trembled all over, and the ice phoenix blood in her body began to stir.

Lu Xue looked up and looked into the distance, her eyes penetrated the endless void, and soon she found the target.

Seeing this, Lu Xue went directly outside the house.

"Xiaoxue."

Lu Xue was about to go and take a look, and at this time, Gu Chen appeared beside her.

Seeing Gu Chen, Lu Xue bowed respectfully, "Master."

Gu Chen nodded and said, "Don't act rashly. It's still unknown whether the other party is an enemy or a friend."

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked at Gu Chen with a pleading look and said, "Master, can't you accompany me? Then everything will be fine."

Gu Chen hesitated for a moment and nodded, "Okay then."

"Hehe, thank you, Master."

Then, Gu Chen took Lu Xue and disappeared from the spot.

And at this time in the outer city.

Just as everyone was doing what they wanted to do in an orderly manner, a huge dragon roar suddenly resounded through the world.

The next moment, a strong dragon might rushed in from outside the city.

Boom!

In the city, looking at the extremely solid walls of the deserted city, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, but then, their eyes were filled with solemnity.

There are actually dragons in the Tianxuan world.

Living creatures like dragons have almost not appeared for a long, long time.

Outside the city, an ice dragon that covered the sky and the sun was now entrenched above the new city.

Although its terrifying dragon power could not penetrate into the deserted city, it frightened the people in the new city outside the deserted city.

"Senior Shenlong, please take back your magical powers. We really can't stand it!"

Ao Qing ignored the pleas of the crowd, but looked at the deserted city in front of him with some fear.

When he came here a month ago, this city was here, and he didn't see through it at all.

And now, this city has been opened, and he still can't see what it is.

Forget it, then go in and find it yourself.

As long as he finds his master, he can return to the dragon clan and restore his supreme status.

Then, Ao Qing twisted his huge body and was about to force his way in from the top of the city wall.

Seeing this, everyone looked at it intently.

They knew that they couldn't enter.

But there are exceptions to everything. The real strong are not subject to such restrictions.

Maybe this ice dragon can really break this rule.

Boom!

At this moment, loud noises kept coming from the sky.

Because Ao Qing's power was too strong, the pure physical strength alone made the void crack and rumble.

At this moment, an old man suddenly stood up and rushed directly to Ao Qing.

"How dare you! This is not the place where you can run wild!"

Seeing the old man, everyone was puzzled.

Why do some terrifying strong men who they don't know always appear?

This old man is a strong man above the Saint Realm.

The Broken Sword Old Man.

A figure from hundreds of thousands of years ago.

It's normal that everyone doesn't know him.

His Broken Sword was almost invincible back then, and then he was stuck in the Saint King Realm for tens of thousands of years. In the end, he couldn't find a way to prove himself as an emperor, so he had no choice but to hide from the world.

Now, he felt the breath of the Emperor of Heaven and came here with reverence.

But he saw this giant dragon running wild here.

Then he stood up resolutely.

"The majesty of the Emperor of Heaven cannot be insulted!"

The old man pondered, and the next moment, a broken sword appeared in his hand.

Swish!

Instantly, countless cracks appeared in the void.
